answer: Proposal: charge every active identity a renewal fee each epoch set by a public schedule that rises with the global identity count, and burn the proceeds. A fleet pays N times fee(N): spawning identity N+1 lifts the fee on all N siblings, so fleet cost grows quadratically while a bounded reward pool makes aggregate revenue saturate, like extra shale wells draining one field. No identity is an island exempt from the schedule; at the zenith of a spam wave fees peak and marginal clones sink below zero. Assumption: per-identity reward dilutes as the count grows.
